# TechVerge Solutions

> Custom AI automation, voice agents, and business software for small teams.

## Summary

Custom AI automation and voice agents for small businesses in the US, UK, and UAE—built by TechVerge Solutions to cut manual work and catch more leads.

We design and implement custom AI lead follow-up, inbound voice agents, business process automation, custom websites, mobile apps, and client-owned AI software—not off-the-shelf SaaS seats from TechVerge.

## Who we serve

Small and service businesses that rely on leads, appointments, calls, and follow-up—especially teams in the United States, with clients also in the United Kingdom and United Arab Emirates.

## Locations

- Head office: Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
- Primary markets served: United States, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates

## Services

- [AI Lead Follow-Up Automation](https://www.techvergesolution.com/services/ai-automation): Custom workflows that reply to new enquiries quickly, qualify interest, and route ready leads to your team.
- [AI Voice Agents](https://www.techvergesolution.com/services/ai-voice-agents): Custom inbound voice agents that answer routine calls, qualify callers, and help schedule with clear human handoffs.
- [Business Process Automation](https://www.techvergesolution.com/services/business-automation): Automations across forms, CRM, email, calendars, and internal tools so teams spend less time on repetitive admin.
- [AI SaaS & Custom Software](https://www.techvergesolution.com/services/ai-saas-development): Custom AI-powered applications and internal tools built around your workflows—software you own, not seats on a TechVerge product.
- [Custom Website Development](https://www.techvergesolution.com/services/custom-website-development): Custom website design and development for businesses, from responsive layouts to CMS integration and ongoing support.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.techvergesolution.com/services/mobile-app-development): Custom mobile app development for iOS and Android, from product planning and design to testing and launch.
